content.text: The only MFN mechanic in the document runs in our favour, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The sole most-favoured-nation mechanic in the Agreement runs in our favour: § 6 (p0047) binds TrueLink to charge Hosting Services rates no higher than those charged to any other party, and also freezes Hosting Services costs for one year. Searches for MFN-style language ("no less favorable", "most favored", third-party matching, "any other party") return no obligation requiring Client to extend TrueLink the benefit of better terms given to third parties, and the COMPENSATION section (sec-5) imposes only payment obligations on Client. This meets the preferred position — no MFN burdening the Customer, with Vendor-granted best pricing retained — so no redline is proposed.
